layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/ie/boi/boi.json (comma, header row, d/m/Y, five columns: date, description, debit, credit, ignored balance)
https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/master/bank2ynab.conf [IE Bank of Ireland] (Date,Payee,Outflow,Inflow,skip; a UUID file name; %d/%m/%Y)
https://www.bankofireland.com/help-centre/faq/can-i-make-changes-to-transactions-on-my-estatements (365 online can export transaction history as a CSV file)
notes: 365 online "Export" CSV for a current account: header Date,Details,Debit,Credit,Balance; unquoted; dd/mm/yyyy; debit and credit as positive figures in their own columns with a point decimal and no thousands mark; Balance after each line. The column order is documented by two importers; the header words, newest-first order, the POSddMMM card prefix and the unquoted plain numbers are the commonly reported form, not confirmed. No currency is written. Closing = the newest line's balance; opening = the oldest line's balance minus its amount.
